set -u
mkdir -p /tmp/empty-home
trap 'cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.events > /out/memory-events.txt; cat /sys/fs/cgroup/memory.peak > /out/memory-peak.txt' EXIT
rustc -Vv > /out/rustc.txt
result=0
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib selection_demand -- --nocapture > /out/demand.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/demand.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/demand.log; then exit 1; fi
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib native_selection -- --nocapture > /out/selection.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/selection.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/selection.log; then exit 1; fi
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib publication_failure -- --nocapture > /out/publication.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/publication.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/publication.log; then exit 1; fi
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib unknown_child -- --nocapture > /out/unknown.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/unknown.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/unknown.log; then exit 1; fi
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib vector_certification_fresh -- --nocapture > /out/admission.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/admission.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/admission.log; then exit 1; fi
cargo test --locked --offline --all-features --lib linked_producer_checked_empty -- --nocapture > /out/advisory.log 2>&1
status=$?
echo $status > /out/advisory.exit
if [ $status -ne 0 ]; then result=1; fi
if grep -q 'could not compile' /out/advisory.log; then exit 1; fi
exit $result
